samples.xml_description:
<module id="pulse_detect">
    <description>Implements pulse detection for the input signal data_in. Detects transitions from 0 to 1 to 0 (3 cycles). Outputs data_out indicating the end of a pulse.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in">One-bit input signal for pulse detection.</input>
        <output id="data_out">Output signal indicating the end of a detected pulse.</output>
    </ports>
    
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="INITIAL">Initial state for pulse detection.</parameter>
        <parameter id="WAIT_FOR_ONE">State waiting for the first rising edge of data_in.</parameter>
        <parameter id="WAIT_FOR_ZERO">State waiting for the falling edge of data_in after detecting the first rising edge.</parameter>
        <parameter id="PULSE_END">State indicating the end of a pulse.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="state" width_description="INITIAL">Current state of the pulse detector.</reg>
        
        // State machine logic for pulse detection
        <always @ (posedge clk or negedge rst_n)> <!-- Trigger on posedge clk or negedge rst_n -->
            <if (~rst_n)>
                <assign state = INITIAL>; <!-- Set state to INITIAL on reset -->
                <assign data_out = 1'b0; <!-- Set data_out to 0 on reset -->
            </if>
            else begin
                case (state)
                    INITIAL: begin
                        if (data_in == 1'b1)
                            <assign state = WAIT_FOR_ZERO>;
                        else
                            <assign state = INITIAL>;
                        <assign data_out = 1'b0;
                    end
                    
                    WAIT_FOR_ONE: begin
                        if (data_in == 1'b1)
                            <assign state = WAIT_FOR_ZERO>;
                        else
                            <assign state = INITIAL>;
                        <assign data_out = 1'b0;
                    end
                    
                    WAIT_FOR_ZERO: begin
                        if (data_in == 1'b0)
                            <assign state = PULSE_END>;
                        else
                            <assign state = INITIAL>;
                        <assign data_out = 1'b0;
                    end
                    
                    PULSE_END: begin
                        <assign state = INITIAL;
                        <assign data_out = 1'b1;
                    end
                    
                    default: begin
                        <assign state = INITIAL;
                        <assign data_out = 1'b0;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        </always>
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>This module implements pulse detection based on the input signal data_in. It uses a state machine to detect transitions from 0 to 1 to 0 (3 cycles). The output signal data_out indicates the end of a pulse.</implementation>
    
    <task></task>
</module>
